newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DEPORTIVO SCRAPE THROUGH IN SPANISH CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DEPORTIVO SCRAPE THROUGH IN SPANISH CUP.

text.p: 1995 Spanish Cup winners Deportivo Coruna had Cameroon goalkeeper Jacques Songo'o to thank after scraping their way into the fourth round of this year's competition by beating Sevilla on penalties on Thursday.

Songo'o saved two of Sevilla's four penalty strikes and saw another hit the bar after teammate Miroslav Djukic had forced extra time with a last-gasp goal to level the third round tie. Deportivo had lost the first leg 2-0.
Deportivo's other goal on a rain-soaked night was scored midway through the first half by newly-signed Brazilian forward Renaldo.
